items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 19 at 9:53PM AKDT until October 20 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 2 and 6
inches, highest amounts near the mountains.

* WHERE...Lower elevations of Anchorage and the Matanuska Valley.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 1 PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Be prepared for slippery
roads. Visibilities as low as one half mile possible, including
during the morning commute.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Rain will intensify during the overnight hours
and change to  snow late tonight through early Tuesday
items.areas: Anchorage; Lower Matanuska Valley; Sutton / Upper Matanuska Valley
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 19 at 5:40PM AKDT until October 21 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will quickly increase Monday evening
into Tuesday morning, with the strongest gusts peaking through
midday Tuesday. Some higher gusts close to 60 mph are possible on
Tuesday. Winds will decrease slightly, but still stay elevated into
Wednesday.
items.areas: Municipality of Skagway
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
Ensure boats and vessels are secure.
